label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

DEX_ORDER_MIN_SIZE.note: TEST minimum amountIn so a journey can open a price-trigger order. Not a product minimum.

DEX_ORDER_RESTRICTED_TOKENS.note: TEST explicit empty restricted list. An unset list still refuses. Not a decision that nothing is restricted.

DEX_ORDER_WARN_TOKENS.note: TEST explicit empty warn list. An unset list still refuses. Nothing is warned.

DEX_ORDER_SLIPPAGE_BPS.note: TEST slippage default in basis points. Not a product default.

DEX_ORDER_ORACLE_MAX_AGE_MS.note: TEST maximum age of a trigger price, in milliseconds. Not a product freshness bound.

DEX_ORDER_KEEPER_INTERVAL_MS.note: TEST keeper period so a local journey can tick. Blank does not start the keeper.

DEX_ORDER_DOMAIN.note: TEST EIP-712 domain so a signed trigger order can be recovered. Not a deployed vault.
